table.name: TLGNR_SAP_ACCOUNT_GROUP_BS
table.description: Account groups as distinguished by SAP. This table encodes special properties of certain account groups as flags, e.g. whether BPs in an account group will be marked as drivers or whether the sold-to partner function will be invented in LOGON for an SAP ship-to in an account group.

column.name: SAP_ACCOUNT_GROUP_CD
column.description: PK. Account group as defined by SAP.

column.name: DESCRIPTION
column.description: Short description of the account group in English.

column.name: BP_IS_DRIVER
column.description: BPs in this account group will be set as drivers.

column.name: TREAT_AS_ONETIME_FLAG
column.description: BPs in this account group will have the TREAT_AS_ONETIME_FLAG set to 1.

column.name: INVENT_SOLDTO_FOR_SHIPTO
column.description: For ship-tos in this account group, the sold-to partner function will be invented in LOGON. In that case, the sold-to must not be sent to SAP in the outgoing interfaces. Also, order taking with this BP as sold-to must only be allowed for STPO and SA contracts.

column.name: INVENT_BILLTO_FOR_SHIPTO
column.description: For ship-tos in this account group, the bill-to partner function will be invented in LOGON. In that case, the bill-to must not be sent to SAP in the outgoing interfaces. Also, order taking with this BP as bill-to must only be allowed for STPO and SA contracts.

column.name: INVENT_PAYER_FOR_SHIPTO
column.description: For ship-tos in this account group, the payer partner function will be invented in LGOON. In that case, the payer must not be sent in the outgoing interfaces. Also, order taking with this BP as payer must only be allowed for STPO and SA contracts.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
